items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: we became friends, you know what I mean... friends and so we've been friends ever since.

ctx.x: Say a little something about that, any incidents that you remember...

Well I remember, I let my card...my dues lapse and I was...when I went with Timmy Rogers, the union man. That's how Clifford Glover and I at the union became friendly. And he knew I was in...you know it was tough scuffling and I was workin' hard. I guess I just forgot about it, you know, and that was his job at that time to check on all jobs and the cards and who, you know, and he was mad at first, you know, but after he saw me and saw what I was doin' and he got to talk to me and then we became friends, you know…
friends and so we've been friends ever since. But that little talk and that little walk and that little lunch that day. You know, he opened my eyes, you know.
